user_instruction: Ok perfect. Lets set this as the new baseline for next release.
name: Portrait Beta3 performance and rotating menus with compact horizontal menu and DS Lite Tate profile

accepted_behavior.horizontal_menu: Align unrotated side-by-side DV1 menu to game pixel grid without changing its 128-game-pixel width
accepted_behavior.tate_reference: Top/Bottom 90 CW; square pixels; LCD Grid 2; full-resolution output alignment measured

known_limitations: Static setup/recovery timing remains unresolved; accepted as development baseline, not a qualified public release.
No new full-game native-framerate or stability claim.
DS Lite profile is a visual approximation, not a colorimeter calibration of a physical DS Lite panel.
Open menu/LCD Grid 2 sweep: rotated left/right, Main-only and Touch-only digital layouts become nearly black; effect-Off controls restore visibility.
Unrotated left/right inherited a cropped noninteger scale after mode changes; a temporary 3x capture is included, persistence remains unqualified.
Native analog LCD Grid 2 shows vertical banding with the current profile; analog menu stays upright and effect-Off controls are clear.
future_work: Start the next release from the pinned Beta3 runtime code and package. Preserve all accepted performance, menus, analog/digital behavior and the separate DS Lite profile recipe. Public release packaging and qualification remain separate.
